name: Resume_Button_Bug_Fix
observations: Fixed 'No saved position to resume from' error that appeared when resume button showed incorrectly
Root cause: stop() method in state-manager.js saved lastStopPosition even when playback completed naturally (currentChunkIndex >= chunks.length)
Solution: Added condition in stop() to only save position if currentChunkIndex < chunks.length
Resume button now only appears when user manually stops playback, not when reading completes naturally

name: StateManager_Class
observations: Manages playback state including chunks, positions, and resume functionality
Key method stop() saves lastStopPosition only if content remains (currentChunkIndex < chunks.length)
resumePlayback() restores state from lastStopPosition and clears it
startPlayback() clears lastStopPosition to prevent showing resume button for new content
